title: mentha × villosa f. nouletiana
intro: Mentha × villosa f. nouletiana, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a hybrid plant species within the mint family, characterized by its distinctive fragrance and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Mountain Mint include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its calming and anti-spasmodic effects, which can help in soothing respiratory issues and relieving symptoms of colds and flu. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its invigorating aroma and therapeutic efficacy.
